text:
taylor (PM): quick post-all-hands check: partners want a single-line flight plan for API -> Console -> Optimize that we can paste into emails. Can we lock owners, short canary durations, and any doc/SKD freezes?

indra (CTO): short: API first, Console after API stable, Optimize beta overlapping Console stabilization. Owners: API=sam, Console=morgan, Optimize=taylor. Keep canaries tight and staggered.

sam (Engineer): API canary: 24h at 2% -> expand to 10% if metrics green -> 7-day observation window before GA. Deploy example: `./ci/deploy --svc api --ver 3.0.0 --canary --pct 2`. Smoke dashboards: /dashboards/api/canary.

morgan (DevEx): docs note: avoid breaking SDK signatures. If Optimize adds flags they must be optional. Doc freeze: API docs 48h before GA; SDK minor bump ok. I'll schedule a 30-min partner "what's changing" session within 48h of GA.

cam (Security): security checklist: telemetry opt-out required for Private. We will ship a dataflow diagram and an opt-in UI for public deployments. Target: complete before Console canary.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: api-service 3.0.0 -> 2% -> 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z

sam (Engineer): infra note: need API endpoint to surface dedicated pool sizes for Console (`GET /internal/pools`). Also confirm autoscale flags exist (`--dedicated --autoscale-min --autoscale-max`). Will open infra ticket.

morgan (DevEx): will add a support checklist & runbook link to the partner note. Also want to include token migration steps (if any) in the SDK changelog.

taylor (PM): summary line to publish: API (owner sam) -> 24h canary @2% -> 7-day observation -> GA. Console (owner morgan) -> parity -> 48-72h canary -> GA. Optimize (owner taylor) -> rolling beta cohorts starting during Console stabilization; telemetry opt-out for Private. Owners to get calendar invites and runbook links.

indra (CTO): add a postmortem link to every canary ticket template. Stagger canaries by at least 48h to reduce blast radius.

morgan (DevEx): will post the partner note + links here once canary start time is finalized. Thanks everyone.
